test_input: Press SPACE repeatedly to keep the bird aloft and navigate through pipes. If the game ends, press R to restart. Press ESCAPE to quit.
expected_win_output: No win condition in this build. The game continues until the bird collides or goes out of bounds (no automatic win).
expected_lose_output:
Visible: 'GAME OVER' rendered centered and 'Final Score: <n>' below it; the top-left shows the numerical score during play.
Console: One or more lines like '[EVENT] SCORE:<n>' as you pass pipes, and a single 'GAME OVER' line when the game ends. If you press R after game over, 'RESTART' is printed. Pressing SPACE prints 'FLAP'. Pressing ESCAPE or closing the window prints 'QUIT'.
notes:
Controls and exact console lines:
- SPACE (KEYDOWN): applies an upward flap; prints exactly 'FLAP' to the console (newline flushed).
- R (KEYDOWN): resets the game to initial state; prints exactly 'RESTART'.
- ESCAPE or window close: quits the game; prints exactly 'QUIT'.
Game events printed:
- On score increment: '[EVENT] SCORE:<n>' where <n> is the new integer score.
- On game over: 'GAME OVER' printed once.
Implementation and files:
- All gameplay, rendering and input are implemented in game/flappy_bird_clone.py. game/__init__.py is an empty package marker.
Assets:
- bird sprite loaded from game/assets/bird.png (must be present).
- pipe sprite loaded from game/assets/pipe_segment.png (must be present).
Behavior and mechanics (implementation details):
- Window title: 'Flappy Bird Clone'. Resolution: 800x600. Background: solid sky-blue (RGB 135,206,235).
- Bird is fixed horizontally at x=100; vertical position is dynamic (bird_y). Gravity = 900 px/s^2; flap sets vertical velocity to -300 px/s.
- Pipes spawn on the right every 1.5 seconds, move left at 200 px/s, each with a randomized gap_y (gap size = 150 px). Scoring occurs when a pipe's right edge passes the bird_x and that pipe hasn't been scored yet.
- Collision detection uses axis-aligned rectangles against pipe segments and screen bounds (top/bottom). Collision or out-of-bounds triggers game over and freezes motion.
- After game over, all motion stops; drawing still shows static final positions and GAME OVER + Final Score text. Pressing R restarts: score reset to 0, bird back to starting vertical position, pipes cleared.
Limitations / notes:
- No audio is played (requirement: no sounds).
- There is no win condition in this build; play continues until loss.
- During initial program startup the reset is performed silently (no 'RESTART' printed) to avoid spurious console output; subsequent user restarts print 'RESTART'.
- Randomness: pipe gap positions are random each spawn; successive pipes typically have differing gap positions.
- All timing uses a fixed 60 FPS clock and dt-based movement.
- Exact numeric values (gravity, flap velocity, speeds, spawn interval) are implemented as specified in source (see game/flappy_bird_clone.py constants).
Test notes:
- To observe scoring: fly the bird through a pipe gap; check console for '[EVENT] SCORE:1' etc. The on-screen score in top-left updates immediately.
- To restart after death: press R; verify 'RESTART' printed and on-screen score returns to 0 and pipes cleared.
- To quit: press ESCAPE or close the window; 'QUIT' printed and application exits.
